entries.text: My dear friends! How ARE you all today? I hope\nyou are doing MARVELOUSLY well![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_01

entries.text: It’s time for another of Salvatore’s Language\nLessons! Êtes-vous prêts—are you ready?![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_02

entries.text: Yes!
entries.label: class_d_06_yes_01

entries.text: Oui!
entries.label: class_d_06_yes_02

entries.text: I would expect no less from my excellent friends!\nEven your replies to my questions are excellent![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_03

entries.text: Aujourd’hui—today—we will once again be\nfocusing on listening![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_04

entries.text: Vas-y—go for it, my assistant! Pika pi, Pikachu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_05

entries.text: Pikachu!
entries.label: class_d_06_poke_01

entries.text: As you may remember from our last class,\nthe same Pokémon’s cries may sound different\r\ndepending on what it wants to say![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_06

entries.text: Aujourd’hui—today, that is—we will be learning\nmore about the language used by Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_07

entries.text: Je t’en prie—if you would be so kind, Pikachu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_08

entries.text: Pikaaa...
entries.label: class_d_06_poke_02

entries.text: Hmmm! That sounds a little bleak, doesn’t it? Its\nvoice seems a little lower pitched, too![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_09

entries.text: What emotion do you suppose Pikachu was\ntrying to convey just now?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_10

entries.text: Happiness
entries.label: class_d_06_select_01

entries.text: Sadness
entries.label: class_d_06_select_02

entries.text: Surprise
entries.label: class_d_06_select_03

entries.text: Say it again, Pikachu!
entries.label: class_d_06_select_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh no, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! That’s
incorrect.\c
Au contraire—on the contrary, I believe it’s
the opposite![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_answer_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ding ding ding! That’s right,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Fantastique![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_answer_02

entries.text:

incorrect.

perhaps,
Pikachu
was
so
surprised
that
it
dropped
a
tasty Berry![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_answer_03

entries.text: When Pikachu says...[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_14

entries.text: Pikaaa...
entries.label: class_d_06_poke_03

entries.text: It’s expressing sadness! Kind of makes you want\nto cry, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_15

entries.text: That’s right—I had my little Pikachu cry as if it\nwas...crying! Haha! Funny joke, right?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_16

entries.text: Don’t you think it did a great job? Give Pikachu\na round of applause, everyone![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_17

entries.text: *clapping*
entries.label: class_d_06_popup_01

entries.text: And now, apropos of nothing, let me give you\nall one of my wise words of advice![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_18

entries.text: If you hear one of your Pokémon making sad\nnoises like this one, you should treat them with\r\neven more kindness than usual.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_19

entries.text: Well, you probably already knew that, though! A\npiece of cake for you all, I’m sure![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_20

entries.text: Of course, this goes for your classmates and\nothers as well![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_21

entries.text: Friends should support each other in times of\nsadness! I truly hope that you all can have smiles\r\non your faces all the time, my friends![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_22

entries.text: Our prochain cours—next lesson, that is—will be\nour final lesson together! I hope you’re ready for\r\nthe climactic finale! Adios! Mata ne![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_06_language_23
